mainEntity.name: What steps are involved in building a bedroom and bathroom addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process begins with an initial consultation and site evaluation to assess your property boundaries, home structure, and utility connections. Next, plans are drafted to align with local building codes, followed by securing required building, electrical, and plumbing permits. Construction starts with foundation work and framing, followed by rough-in work for plumbing, electrical, and HVAC. Once rough-in inspections pass, drywall is installed, finished, and prepped for paint. Finally, exterior finishes like stucco are completed, bathroom fixtures, tile, and flooring are installed, and local inspectors perform final evaluations before the space is ready for move-in.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes design and permitting, foundation and framing, plumbing and electrical rough-ins, drywall, exterior finishing, fixture installation, and final inspections.
